svg.title: Passive top view of twenty provisional System 5 term variants
svg.desc: Ten provisional term families form objective and subjective rings. Proposed R-n cyclic relations follow the rings, proposed P-k projections connect each family pair, and a separate inset shows proposed V-i-j notation for source virtual-image pairs. No runtime behavior is implied.
